$comment: Contract for data/tables/family_entries.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js.
title: Family entries
description: Canonical names that are families or aliases, not materials (D44). Each is a materials.csv row with Scope Family entry; it owns no product, carries no value, and search answers with its members (family_members.csv). The build fails if this table and the Scope disagree.

fields.name: MaterialID
fields.description: The family entry's row in materials.csv.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: family: a group of materials; alias: another name for one material.

fields.name: Why
fields.description: Why this name is a family or alias, and where its products are filed.
